Only the professional who is selected is charged, at the moment of selection. The client does not pay again; their credits are returned only if the case is closed without a replacement.

AdminSettings.s_credit_price_eur_help: Purchase price of one credit outside a package. Boat delivery costs are converted to credits at this price.
AdminSettings.s_signup_credits_professional_help: Credited when the account is verified.
AdminSettings.s_signup_credits_client_help: Credited when the account is verified. 0: no gift.
AdminSettings.s_client_request_fee_help: Per position, when the client sends a request. Refunded if nobody takes it. 0: free for clients.
AdminSettings.s_skipper_claim_fee_help: Charged when the professional takes a request.
AdminSettings.s_unclaimed_expiry_hours_label: How long a client request stays valid
AdminSettings.s_unclaimed_expiry_hours_help: After this many hours without acceptance the request expires and the client's reserved credit is released.
AdminSettings.s_delivery_expiry_hours_label: How long a delivery offer stays valid
AdminSettings.s_delivery_expiry_hours_help: How long a role offer on a boat delivery stays open before it expires.
AdminSettings.s_pro_response_hours_help: From the confirmation of a booking, the professional has this many hours to reply to messages. If they do not, the client can cancel at no cost to themselves.
AdminSettings.s_delivery_skipper_rate_per_mile_help: The platform commission for a skipper is calculated from this (× miles). It is not the skipper's pay, which is agreed freely.
AdminSettings.s_delivery_platform_fee_pct_help: Percentage of (miles × role base): the total cost per position in €, converted to credits at the credit price.
AdminSettings.s_delivery_min_fee_help: The professional uses the equivalent in credits when taking a job; the client uses the remainder, also in credits.
AdminSettings.s_otp_enabled_help: "Yes": new sign-ups are verified automatically with an SMS code and "Forgot password" works by SMS. "No": you verify each new sign-up yourself (Approvals).
AdminSettings.s_otp_enabled_warn: Set "Yes" only after an SMS provider is connected in Supabase, otherwise nobody will be able to sign up.
AdminSettings.s_reliability_min_history_label: Minimum history for a reliability rate
AdminSettings.s_reliability_min_history_help: Below this many completed or cancelled bookings, no rate is shown.
AdminSettings.s_cancellation_flag_review_threshold_hel: How many cancellations before an account is flagged for review.
AdminSettings.s_cancel_early_days_help: A cancellation this many days or more before the trip counts as early (light weight).
AdminSettings.s_cancel_late_days_help: A cancellation fewer days before the trip counts as last-minute (heavy).
AdminSettings.s_cancel_weight_early_help: How much an early cancellation "counts" (1 = as much as a standard one).
AdminSettings.s_cancel_weight_mid_help: For cancellations between early and last-minute.
AdminSettings.s_cancel_weight_late_help: How much a last-minute cancellation counts.
AdminSettings.s_cancel_weight_after_start_help: Cancellation after the trip has started, the worst case.
AdminSettings.s_cancel_decay_full_months_label: A cancellation counts in full for
AdminSettings.s_cancel_decay_full_months_help: It counts in full up to this many months afterwards; then it begins to "fade".
AdminSettings.s_cancel_decay_zero_months_help: From this many months onwards it does not count at all.
AdminSettings.s_cancel_prior_jobs_help: Every professional starts as if they had this many clean jobs, so a single cancellation does not ruin them from the start.
AdminSettings.s_cancel_full_rate_help: When cancellations reach this share of jobs (0.5 = one in two), the ranking in search drops to the lowest.
AdminSettings.previewTitle: As the user sees it (saved values)
AdminSettings.moreExpensive: more expensive than a single credit
AdminSettings.confirmOtp: Enable SMS verification? If no SMS provider is connected in Supabase, no new user will be able to sign up.
AdminSettings.title: Settings
AdminSettings.subtitle: Apply immediately to every new action. They do not change anything already charged.
AdminSettings.group_reliability_subtitle: How cancellations weigh on the ranking of professionals. The defaults are sensible. Change them only if you know what you want to achieve.
AdminSettings.unsavedChanges: {count, plural, one {# change not saved} other {# changes not saved}}
AdminSettings.s_board_max_days_label: Maximum open time of a request
AdminSettings.s_board_max_days_help: A request on the board stays open until the client chooses, for at most this many days.
AdminSettings.s_board_after_start_days_help: The request stays open at most until this many days after the trip starts, whichever comes first.
AdminSettings.s_board_max_claims_help: How many professionals can claim the same request at once.
AdminSettings.s_client_request_limit_help: How many requests a client can send in 24 hours. Per account it is changed from the user page; admins and the owner have no limit.
